findings_for_the_live_window: state/config/occamy-inspect-pre.json records HostConfig.AutoRemove=true -- production is an --rm container, so `docker stop` DESTROYS it and `docker start` has nothing to start (the defect WIN-SGL hit live). LaunchSession.assert_stop_safe() refuses before any create; the live card must run the stop-safety rewrite first.

The same spec carries no --page-size, no --radix-eviction-policy, no --disable-chunked-prefix-cache: a window on any of the three adds a flag rather than changing one. The delta guard reports it as `added` (correct), and PRODUCTION_DEFAULTS records lru as production's implicit eviction policy so a slru window is still a provable single delta.
Production control surface is `systemctl --user gx10-occamy-nvfp4.service`, not the container: systemd recreates the container within a second, so a container-level stop cannot hold :8012 free.
max_total_num_tokens is re-profiled from free memory at every start (MEASURED: 1,306,681 -> 1,644,272, no flag changed) -- restore_keys gates config only and reports capacity with its delta.
assumptions: R2-SGL-PREP's contract is the card prompt plus the batch frame (variant launcher + G0 window gate); the two levers exercised in the dry-run evidence (--radix-eviction-policy, --page-size, --disable-chunked-prefix-cache) are the levers named in WIN-SGL's and R-SGL's own next_unit_hint, chosen as representative rather than as a decision about which window runs.

PRODUCTION_DEFAULTS['--radix-eviction-policy'] = 'lru' is taken from the SGLang radix_eviction_policy documentation already pinned in this repo (scratch/cache-audit/docs/pin_sgl_radix_eviction_policy.mdx, 'lru' listed first and documented as the default). No live request was made to confirm it; the live window's G0 captures /get_server_info, which carries the resolved policy.
The gate's MIN_REQUESTS=2 floor is a judgement: a gate that cannot pay for its cold+warm probes is not a gate. A window may raise the budget, never lower it below 2.
next_unit_hint: The live R2-SGL window card should import both modules rather than re-implement them: `LaunchSession(executor, spec, config)` for the container dance (assert_stop_safe BEFORE create, prove_restore AFTER start) and `run_gate(cfg, send=runner.send, tokenizer=runner.tokenize)` before the first measured row, refusing via `assert_gate`. Two gaps this unit could not close offline and the window card must handle: (1) the SGLang /tokenize route is available (WIN-VLLM measured vLLM 404s) so the gate's tokenizer path is live-untested -- if it 404s the gate still passes, it just loses the offset; (2) the gate's C5b window check calls the tokenizer once per gate run, which counts as a request on a vLLM-shaped endpoint and must be metered against the cap.
